explanation: A NULL in the subquery poisoned the NOT IN operator, returning 0 rows.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INT, name TEXT, status TEXT); INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'Alice', 'active'), (2, 'Bob', NULL), (3, 'Charlie', 'active');
ground_truth_query: SELECT name FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE status = 'active');
buggy_llm_query: SELECT name FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE status = 'active');

explanation: COUNT(column) silently ignores rows where the column is NULL, undercounting total records.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INT, customer_id INT); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 101), (2, NULL), (3, 103);

explanation: Omitting the JOIN condition multiplies row outputs via Cartesian product.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE departments (id INT, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE staff (id INT, dept_id INT, name TEXT); INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1, 'Engineering'), (2, 'Marketing'); INSERT INTO staff VALUES (1, 1, 'Alice'), (2, 2, 'Bob');
ground_truth_query: SELECT s.name, d.name FROM staff s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.id;
buggy_llm_query: SELECT s.name, d.name FROM staff s, departments d;

trap_name: Aggregate filtering in WHERE instead of HAVING
explanation: Using aggregate functions in the WHERE clause triggers a syntax execution error.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE sales (region TEXT, amount INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('North', 500), ('North', 200), ('South', 300);
ground_truth_query: SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) > 400;
buggy_llm_query: SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM sales WHERE SUM(amount) > 400 GROUP BY region;

explanation: LLMs often assume SQL string matching is case-insensitive by default, failing strict collation rules.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INT, email TEXT); INSERT INTO accounts VALUES (1, 'Admin@Company.com'), (2, 'user@company.com');
ground_truth_query: SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE email = 'Admin@Company.com';
buggy_llm_query: SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE email = 'admin@company.com';
